title: A call without a credential never reaches a master route
description: A caller that sends no Authorization header at all tries one write route of each master router (organisation sites, location nodes, code resolve, the generic import). Each is refused with 401 before the handler runs, so nothing is written and nothing is read. Not walked here (the runner always signs with the actor's own valid token and cannot forge one): a wrong or expired token, a token of another company's realm, an unknown host. Those stay in the row's gap field, owner: the runner maintainer (a step option for a bad bearer), and are covered by the Elixir tests of the auth pipeline. Creates nothing, so there is no cleanup. Needs modules org, locations and codes installed.

steps.says: Without a sign-in an organisation site cannot be created: 401.
Without a sign-in a location node cannot be created: 401.
Without a sign-in a scanned value is not looked up: 401, not 404.
Without a sign-in the generic import is refused: 401.
